scripts.lint: bun scripts/ensure-doc-pack.ts && biome check . && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:web: bun build src/core/aw.ts --target browser --format esm --outfile web/aw.js && bun build src/web/page.ts --target browser --format esm --outfile web/page.js --external /aw.js --external '*/aw.js'
scripts.build:js: bun run build:web && bun scripts/pack-docs.ts && bun scripts/build-js.ts
scripts.build:bin: bun run build:web && bun scripts/pack-docs.ts && bun scripts/build-js.ts --compile
